definitions.explanation: The quality of being based on or in accordance with reason or logic. Often used in compound forms.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{合理|ごうり}{性|せい}→合理性：05808_gourisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦{合理|ごうり}{的|てき}→合理的：06199_gouriteki⟧な⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{合理|ごうり}{化|か}→合理化：17148_gourika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The company is promoting the rationalization of operations.

notes:
USAGE: {合理|ごうり} is rarely used alone; it typically appears in compound forms:

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{合理|ごうり}{的|てき}→合理的：06199_gouriteki⟧ (rational - na-adjective)
- ⟦{合理|ごうり}{性|せい}→合理性：05808_gourisei⟧ (rationality - noun)
- ⟦{合理|ごうり}{化|か}→合理化：17148_gourika⟧ (rationalization, streamlining)
- {合理|ごうり}⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧ (rationalism)

Note that ⟦{合理|ごうり}{化|か}→合理化：17148_gourika⟧ in business contexts often has the negative connotation of 'downsizing' or 'cutting costs' (sometimes at workers' expense).

CONTRAST: ⟦{不合理|ふごうり}→不合理：11482_fugouri⟧ means 'irrational' or 'unreasonable.'
